messages:
Priya S: heads-up: planning a config-only deploy in the 17:10-17:40 PT window to tighten tenant routing and reduce cross-tenant head-of-line tail. Changes: routing.weight_floor default 0.2 -> 0.4, per-tenant batch_size cap 64 -> 32, request timeout soft 14s -> 11s. will run canary 15%->50%->100% with 8m holds. Requesting ops watch.
Noah L: run deploy-bot dry-run and paste diff. Ill add a short-lived p99/5xx alert and increase trace sampling for affected tenants.
deploy-bot: dry-run OK (cset-2048). Diff summary: +routing.defaults.weight_floor=0.4, +batching.per_tenant.max_batch=32, +timeouts.request_ms=11000. No validation errors.
Priya S: config snippet for visibility:
```json
{"routing": {"defaults": {"weight_floor": 0.4}}, "batching": {"per_tenant": {"max_batch": 32}}, "timeouts": {"request_ms": 11000}}
```
InfraBot: scheduled rollout 2024-01-15T17:12:00-08:00. Canary plan: 15% -> 50% -> 100% over 9 minutes, 8m hold between steps. Auto-pin rule: if p99 > +300ms or 5xx > 1% for 3m -> halt.
Noah L: kicking off.
deploy-bot: canary 15% applied. No immediate errors.
ops-robot: canary hosts healthy. CPU ~38%, mem stable. obs: https://console.redwood/obs/cset-2048
Priya S: seeing small reduction in avg batch size as expected. p95 stable.
Noah L: advance to 50%.
deploy-bot: rollout 50% complete.
ops-robot: alert firing: tenant-101 p99 increased by ~420ms and 1.6% 5xx concentrated on host inference-22. Traces show increased queuing and a backend model variant fallthrough.
Priya S: interesting. This tenant has affinity to inference-22. Instead of full rollback can we remap tenant-101 away from inference-22 to previous routing while keeping global config? That would be a per-tenant sticky remap, not a full config revert.
Noah L: we have a hot remap API for tenant routing pins. I can issue a remap to prefer inference-09/inference-11 for tenant-101 for 30m and leave the rest of the rollout. Doing that now.
Noah L: POST /ops/remap {"tenant":"tenant-101","prefer_hosts":["inference-09","inference-11"],"ttl_s":1800} -> accepted.
deploy-bot: remap applied; tenant-101 traffic diverted.
ops-robot: post-remap telemetry: p99 for tenant-101 back to baseline within 90s, 5xx cleared. Host inference-22 p99 remains elevated for other tenants by ~120ms.
Priya S: good remediation. Hold at 50% for 12m to observe cross-tenant effects. Raising follow-up ticket RED-800 to investigate why the weight_floor change raised queuing on inference-22 (could be imbalance or model variant demotion).
Noah L: pulling traces and sampling shows that weight_floor lifted some low-weight traffic onto hotspots. Plan: next attempt will include soft host-affinity smoothing and staggered warmup.
InfraBot: scheduled next rollout attempt in 24h with adjusted plan: weight_floor ramp 0.3->0.4 over 10m, host-affinity-smoothing enabled.
Priya S: thanks all. TL;DR  config-only routing/batching change caused tenant-hotspot p99 +5xx at 50% canary; resolved with a per-tenant remap instead of full rollback, holding rollout and filing RED-800 for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
